title: magnolia candollei var. beccarii
intro: Magnolia candollei var. beccarii, commonly known as the Philippine Magnolia, is a plant species native to the Philippines. It is a deciduous tree known for its medicinal properties and is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Philippine Magnolia include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties, which may help to alleviate symptoms of colds, flu, and respiratory infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include triterpenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of antitumor, antioxidant, and anti-inflammatory activities.
